author: Mark Atwood
text: Fixed. handle_calendar_event_parse now validates blobIds and properties via serde_json::from_value, mirroring the canonical jmap-mail-server::handle_email_parse pattern at crate-jmap-mail-server/src/email.rs:2193. Non-string entries now produce invalidArguments (RFC 8620 §3.6.1) instead of being silently dropped via filter_map. Missing/null blobIds still produces an empty result rather than an error (preserves the deliberate calendars-server divergence from the canonical's 'blobIds is required' shape, which is its own scope of work). Added two regression tests (parse_non_string_blob_id_returns_invalid_arguments, parse_non_string_property_returns_invalid_arguments) with explicit RFC 8620 §3.6.1 / draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §5.13 oracle citations. Verified: cargo fmt clean, clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean, cargo test --all-features 119+13+1 passed.
